title: Card Benefit Terms: Cardholder Bonus on Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry Rewards
content:
**Benefit.** A registrant who holds an active account with the Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards program earns a rewards card holder bonus on the registry rewards that guests' gifts accrue on her or his Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry. The bonus is added, in percentage points, to the percent at which each guest gift accrues, on a registry type whose registry rewards percent is above zero, and follows the registrant's Marlowe & Finch card accounts as they stand when the accrual is booked:

- an active Marlowe & Finch Store Card Elite or Marlowe & Finch World Elite Mastercard adds the elite holder rewards bonus of **2** percentage points;
- any other active Marlowe & Finch card account, where no elite account is held, adds the holder rewards bonus of **1** percentage point;
- otherwise no rewards card holder bonus is added.

**Holdings and bonus (hypothetical registrants)**

| Active Marlowe & Finch card accounts held by the registrant | Bonus |
|---|---|
| Store Card Elite | 2 |
| World Elite Mastercard and Store Card | 2 |
| Store Card Plus only | 1 |
| Platinum Mastercard only | 1 |
| a closed World Elite Mastercard and an active Mastercard | 1 |
| none active | none |

**Points of judgement**

- The bonus follows what the registrant holds, not the card the guest paid with.
- An elite account counts only while it is active.
- A registry type whose registry rewards percent is zero accrues nothing, with or without this bonus.
